points.zh: 因为一切都要从脚下开始。
points.en: because it all starts from the ground up.
points.why: 发力链起点，脚不稳则上肢代偿

points.zh: 你应该让你的 10 个脚趾全都对着篮筐。
points.en: you should have your 10 toes facing squared up to the rim.
points.why: 10 趾同向 = 身体正对篮筐，决定了肩髋能否水平

points.zh: 但它们都朝着同一个方向。
points.en: But they're all pointing in the same direction.
points.why: 两脚朝向一致，避免髋部扭转传导到肩

points.zh: 把你的脚踩在地板上去感受。
points.en: is something that you need to get out on the floor
points.why: 本体感觉：脚掌贴地是稳定的前提

points.zh: 蓄力到我们的臀部、下背部。
points.en: Loading our hips, our backside, and getting
points.why: 下蹲发力来自髋，不是膝盖前顶

points.zh: 膝盖不要超过脚趾。
points.en: And we don't want to have our knees in front of our toes.
points.why: 膝超脚尖会失去后链发力，且重心前倾

points.zh: 所以找到足弓是关键，稳定足弓。
points.en: So finding that arch is key, planting it into the ground,
points.why: 足弓塌陷会让整个发力链向内偏移

points.zh: 如果你的膝盖向外，你就会用力过大（损失力量）。
points.en: If you bend your knees outward, you'll sacrifice power.
points.why: 膝外翻 = 力量泄漏，对应下蹲深度与膝角

points.zh: 【10 个脚趾朝向同一方向】（画面提示卡）
points.en: POINT ALL 10 TOES IN THE SAME DIRECTION
points.why: 本章核心口令

points.zh: 让球正确地旋转。
points.en: to get proper spin on the ball, and also
points.why: 后旋来自手指拨球，不是手掌推球

points.zh: 要有一点空间（掌心与球之间）。
points.en: in between my palm and the ball with the ball sitting
points.why: 掌心不贴球 → 手指控制方向，出手更稳

points.zh: （手指在）球的哪个位置。
points.en: position is on the ball.
points.why: 手指落点决定旋转轴

points.zh: 找到篮球上的气孔。
points.en: finding the air valve on the basketball,
points.why: 气孔作为食指定位的触觉锚点

points.zh: 把食指放在气孔上，用这个姿势盯着篮筐。
points.en: just staring at the rim doing form shooting with your finger
points.why: 食指对准篮筐 = 肘部自然内收

points.zh: 对我来说，我觉得最舒服的是——
points.en: For me, what I feel is most comfortable-- when
points.why: 瞄准点是个人化选择

points.zh: 看着篮筐的前部。
points.en: on those hooks, looking at the front of the rim
points.why: 瞄前沿 → 需要更高弧线才能入框

points.zh: 只要轻轻一触，有一点弧线。
points.en: over the front of the rim with a little bit of touch,
points.why: 弧线 = 出手角，弧线不足则入射角太平

points.zh: 或者打断我瞄准篮筐的角度和视线。
points.en: or to interrupt my angle or my eyesight to the basket.
points.why: 出手瞬间视线不离开篮筐

points.zh: 出手点是投篮中非常重要的一部分。
points.en: Your release point is a very important part of your shot
points.why: 出手点高度与时机决定被封盖概率

points.zh: 这才能让你有恰当的弧度。
points.en: That's going to give you proper arc
points.why: 出手点 + 手臂伸展共同决定弧线

points.zh: 从臀部到出手位置要呈完美的线条。
points.en: We want to have kind of a perfect line from my hip
points.why: 髋-肩-肘-腕成一条竖线，最关键的姿势判据

points.zh: 伸出去一点点。
points.en: It's just a little bit out.
points.why: 跟随动作不用夸张，自然延伸即可

points.zh: 如果你在篮筐前面做这个动作（跟随动作歪斜）。
points.en: If you do this follow through right in front of the basket,
points.why: 跟随动作不对称 → 左右偏差

points.zh: 会让球有从左到右的侧旋。
points.en: the left to right action in side spin.
points.why: 侧旋 = 左右手不对称发力，球会左右飘

points.zh: 如果大于这个弧度（出手角过高）。
points.en: Anything higher than that, you start
points.why: 出手角过高 → 力量不足/短

points.zh: 因为它会导致球左右不平衡的运动轨迹。
points.en: as it'll cause left to right or right to left movement of the ball.
points.why: 左右不对称的最终后果：轨迹左右漂移
